eventLocation: Green Forest Garden (Nandavanam) at the Vallakkottai Murugan Temple
eventDescription: As a noble initiative that brings together nature conservation and spiritual service, Vidhaigal Organization is developing a Green Forest Garden (Nandavanam) at the Vallakkottai Murugan Temple. As part of this ongoing mission, the Vallakkottai Murugan Temple Administration, Rotary Grand Kanchipuram, Agathiya Matric Higher Secondary School, Walajabad, and Rasi Engineering College jointly organized a tree plantation programme, during which 150 Indian Mahua (Iluppai) saplings were planted.
